name: SP Group A/S
summary: SP Group A/S, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells moulded plastic and composite components in Denmark, rest of Europe, the Americas, Asia, the Middle East, Australia, and Africa. The company offers hydrographic printing, electromagnetic shielding, other coatings; solid, foamed, flexible, and light-foam polyurethane products; and ventilation equipment, ergonomic matting, and striping products.
